summary: Enhance your skills with our Pension Fraud Prevention and Risk Management Training Course. Equip yourself to identify and mitigate fraud risks effectively.
lede: Pension fraud prevention and risk management helps professionals in pension operations, governance, compliance, and oversight identify vulnerabilities and protect scheme funds. Participants learn to map risks across the pension lifecycle, assess controls, spot warning signs in records and transactions, and use basic analytics to detect anomalies. They also practise designing preventive measures and coordinating a response when fraud is suspected.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in pension scheme operations, governance, compliance, or oversight. These individuals regularly make decisions that affect fraud risk and controls, and are essential to safeguarding retirement funds.
audience: Pension fund managers and scheme administrators
Trustees and board members of retirement benefit
Compliance and risk management officers in pension
modules: Understanding Pension Fraud and Why It Matters
Mapping the Pension Lifecycle and Vulnerable Points
Red Flags, Fraud Typologies, and Early Warning Signs
Internal Controls and Governance for Pension Fraud Prevention
Risk Assessment for Pension Fraud and Misconduct
Using Data, Analytics, and Technology to Detect Pension Fraud
Regulation, Compliance, and Reporting in Pension Fraud Management
Investigating Suspected Pension Fraud and Managing Incidents
Culture, Ethics, and Whistleblowing in Pension Environments
Building a Sustainable Pension Fraud Prevention and Risk Management Framework
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of pension operations and financial management principles. Experience in governance, compliance, or risk management is beneficial but not required.
